Just started doing face pulls to rehab my injured left shoulder -- Any critiques/thoughts on my form?

Going very high to the point that it is a raise, not a pull, but I don't think you're hurting yourself. Which part of your shoulder needs to be strengthened? If you need to work on your rear shoulder and the rotator cuff stabilizers, check this out. I do these band flys once a week and it's way easier to isolate the rear shoulder vs a cable machine.

I think I have a tear in my supraspinitus. It is extremely weak. I seem to have tightness in that area which makes it difficult to externally rotate. I've been stretching it for 9 months and I've come a long way but I do not have full ROM yet. I am trying to do face pulls to strengthen the posterior shoulder muscles. This will help me with my upper cross syndrome.

Thank you for your comment. I'll c heck out that video.

Rehabbing for range of motion can be painful work. I wish you well. I had to do that for my hand a few years back. Another quick isolation exercise for rear shoulders is the machine reverse fly, here. If you've never done these it's done on the chest fly machine you just move the bars to the far back position and straddle the seat with your chest on the back rest. The video mentions going light weight. The rear deltoid is a tiny band of muscle, for most men going heavier than 50lbs overloads the deltoid and it becomes a back exercise, FYI. On a machine you'll find it's very easy to go heavy on a reverse fly, so keep it light to target it. 30lbs is plenty.
I go much lower on mine. The middle of the rope just about hits my nose. It's almost like a shoulder pivot to get the pull to your nose/forehead

Set your shoulder blades before you do any exercise involving the shoulder. Do this by retracting them, depressing them, and making sure they are pressing against your posterior ribcage (no winging), then do the work out. This will help avoiding re-injuring your shoulder. I wouldn't go that far above your head for this particular exercise; aim at your nose and focus on the retraction/horizontal abduction and external rotation motions.

While this exercise does recruit the supraspinatus, an exercise that has more isolation on it would be something that is straight abduction at the shoulder joint. Upright rows is a good one!

It has today been announced that the general elections for Mauritius will take place in February 2019. It was due to take place in late 2018, but was postponed due to the sudden illness and eventual passing of Prime Minister Anerood Jugnauth. The initial frontrunners appear to be MSM and PMSD, however the Labour Party can have a large influence depending on the alliances that they make.

The bookmakers favourite to take control is the Mouvement Socialiste Militant party. The leader of MSM and the son of the late Anerood Jugnauth is Pravind Jugnauth. His experience in the previous government's cabinet and the huge popularity of his father have given Jugnauth a lot of support from the Mauritian public. However, his detractors point to the Medpoint scandal and his conflict of interest in that matter. There have even been accusations of corruption in relation to that incident. His main opponent is expected to be Xavier Luc Duval, the Deputy Prime Minister and current Interim Prime Minister. His role in the popular and successful previous regime will give the public confidence in his abilities. However, he may alienate parts of the electorate with his parties right wing ideology due to the mostly left leaning governments since the start of the republic. A good turnout is expected, with around 79% predicted to turn up to polling stations to vote.

So, does a Trump trump a Bern, or does a Bern burn a Trump?

A Trump can sometimes trump a Bern, but the more common occurrence is that the Bern with burn the Trump.

In 1956, scientists at MIT published the findings of a ten year study on whether a Trump will trump a Bern or whether a Bern will burn a Trump. It was found that Trumps only trump Berns with a 2% success rate. However, they were shocked to find that a Bern will burn a Trump 59% of the time. The remaining 39% was an unexpected result where the Bern and the Trump will meld together and explode. The explosions produced were so severe that 3 scientists died and 6 were grievously injured. Because of this, nobody has attempted such a study since.
